note: git_status_all now returns a pm_store entry on every path (non-hub, empty hub, hub) built by _pm_store_status, which wraps worktree.store_git_state in try/except so the dashboard can never fail on it (the mocked-subprocess dashboard tests still pass). Summary strings keep their existing prefixes ("All N projects clean.", "Not a hub project.") and append "PM store: <description>". format_git_status prints the store line under the header; the CLI git-status --json carries pm_store; server pm_git_status keeps pm_store in the single-project filter. Tests: TestGitStatusReportsTheStoreDistinctly (9) incl. store dirty/ahead separate from main's unpushed commit, TestCli (6), TestMcpTools (5).
